findings.title: A missing, None or unknown route_a_outcome.outcome with driver status ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT is counted as a model outcome
findings.evidence: cause_record_cxv002.py L81, L95-105: token = status unless outcome is ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; only FAILED_SOURCE_PREPARATION is excluded (L82). My probe on the builder's fixtures: outcome key absent, outcome None, route_a_outcome absent and outcome 'NONCONVERGENCE' all give model_outcome true. The driver site L1916 (classification ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT) also fires for FAILED_SOURCE_PREPARATION, so an absent outcome cannot be told apart from that excluded case. Not reachable from honest producers: every route-A request passes --checkpoint-module and --checkpoint-directory (driver r5 L2839-2841), and every iterator _finish writes checkpoint.outcome, which is always one of CONVERGED_FINITE_FIXED_POINT, FAILED_SOURCE_PREPARATION or ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (all 5 pinned iterators).
findings.fix: One line: if outcome is None or not one of the pinned iterator tokens, return no('ROUTE_A_OUTCOME_MISSING_OR_UNKNOWN'). This matches current behavior on every honest record. Separately, the builder's positive fixture uses outcome 'NONCONVERGENCE' (test L17), a token no pinned iterator emits; the positive cases should use ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
